reason: Rails' `hash.digest.unpack("NnnnnN")` (digest/uuid.rb:34) reads six big-endian fields out of a byte String; a JS string cannot hold bytes, so trails reads the same six fields off a `DataView` over the digest's `Uint8Array`. There is no `unpack` to call.

Rails' `match_data.captures.map { |s| s.to_i(16) }.pack("NnnnnN")` (digest/uuid.rb:70) round-trips the hex captures back through a packed String; trails parses the joined hex straight to a `Uint8Array`, so neither `map` nor `pack` has a caller.
